risk_note: Admin 用户查询 【导出】【导出记录】 (apps/admin pages/users/**, texts/users.ts). Contract CT-24k adminCreateExport with resource=users; backend B1-34f merged. 【导出】 appears only with export and user.list (only on the list, never on the detail); 【导出记录】 links to the existing exports page. The default export is masked: body {resource:'users', filters:<applied risk filter>} without unmasked, reason, step-up token, Idempotency-Key or identity fields; one POST per click (each call creates a task). With pii.reveal_phone an optional 「导出完整手机号」 checkbox requires a reason (trimmed, 1-200, rule stated in the hint) and a totp step-up, then adds unmasked:true and reason. Success closes the dialog with a message pointing to 导出记录; 10403 / 20001 / network failures keep the dialog with a notice. No frozen test changed. Rule tests written by an independent Claude; Claude spec-test review r1 pass (three S2 carried into the implementation constraints); red on the test machine (red/1). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine browser green; the container verify-fast could not finish because tsc ran out of heap repository-wide (reported), so the orchestrator ran the jsdom user-page specs on the host (28 files, 176 tests green) before and after rebasing on main; full verification by the required CI checks. Adversarial money review by a fresh independent Claude r1 pass with one S2 (reason length counted in UTF-16 units, stricter than the server; follow-up). Written by hand.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagent: round 1 pass with three S2 carried into the implementation constraints; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
